up: Return a list of IC50 activity values (in nM) for compounds tested against human TYK2. For each result, include: the compound's ChEMBL ID, its canonical SMILES, the PubMed ID (or DOI if PubMed ID is not available), the assay description, and the target information (preferably the target name). Return the standard value and units from the activities table.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.pref_name = 'Tyrosine-protein kinase TYK2'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM';
